strings.long_src: What number shall I dial?

strings.en: Лучше нам больше не лезть в их дела.
strings.en_src: We should stay out of their affairs￥now.

strings.long_src: Don't call

strings.en: Какой там номер видеофона у Джейми?
Ты будешь часто ей звонить. Внесу￥номер в быстрый набор.
strings.en_src: You'll be calling her often. I'll￥put it on speed dial.

strings.en: ＠赤Н-не так уж часто я ей звоню!＠白
strings.en_src: ＠赤I-I won't call her that often!＠白
It's fine.￥No need to be shy.
strings.long_src: It's all right. No need to be￥embarrassed.

strings.en: Вношу домашний номер Джейми в￥быстрый набор ＠赤01＠白.
strings.en_src: I'll put Jamie's home number on￥speed dial ＠赤01＠白.
Don't forget it again. Heh heh.

strings.en: Быстрый набор ＠赤01＠白. Уж две цифры можно￥запомнить?
strings.en_src: Speed dial ＠赤01＠白.￥It's two digits, so remember it.
strings.long_src: It's speed dial ＠赤01＠白. You can remember￥two digits, can't you?

strings.en: Он может нам пригодиться. Внесу его￥номер в быстрый набор.
strings.en_src: He could be useful to us. I'll put￥his number on speed dial.

strings.en: Вношу номер Наполеона в быстрый￥набор ＠赤05＠白.
strings.long_src: I'll put Napoleon's number on speed￥dial ＠赤05＠白.

strings.en_src: It's speed dial ＠赤05＠白. Remember that!

strings.en: Какой номер видеофона был на￥салфетках, что нам дали у￥"Альтамиры"?
strings.en_src: What was the videophone number on￥those tissues we got outside￥Altamira?
What number did they give me￥for the quiz answer?
strings.long_src: What was the videophone number we￥got for answering the quiz￥correctly?
strings.long: Какой номер видеофона нам дали за￥правильный ответ в викторине?

strings.en: Какой номер видеофона был на￥салфетках, что нам дали у￥"Альтамиры"?
strings.en_src: What was the videophone number on￥those tissues we got outside￥Altamira?

strings.long_src: Old man's house

strings.en: Какой номер у того старика возле￥дома Ивана?
strings.en_src: The old man by Ivan's place.￥His number was...
strings.long_src: What was the number for that old man￥outside Ivan's house?

strings.en: Ты же видел, как она ушла.
strings.en_src: You saw her leave, didn't you?
Who on earth is Jamie talking to?

strings.long_src: Someone told you, didn't they?
Could it be another man?
You'll have another fight if you￥keep that up.
Whose number is that?

strings.en_src: She's gone out. Let's hurry to￥Altamira ourselves.

strings.long_src: Oh, it's you. Need some information?
That's right. I need your help.
All right. How about the password￥first?

strings.en: Что, опять? Да брось. Это правда я.
strings.en_src: What, again? Give me a break. It's￥really me.

strings.en: Видеофонный звонок легко подделать.￥Я просто осторожен.
strings.en_src: A videophone call is easy to fake.￥Just being careful.

strings.long_src: Come on. Think of it as our little￥greeting.

strings.en: Гиллиан, как ты понял, что он￥информатор Жана?
strings.en_src: Gillian, how did you know he was￥Jean's informant?
Guys like him have always been￥informants.

strings.long_src: Is that how it works?
What are you mumbling about?
Ready? Here's the password!
＠赤The revolution is?
＠赤The Hundred Days?
Not even close!
You just repeated it back to me.
What a tired old slogan.
Are you talking about England?
Are you trying to get it wrong?
Don't answer
Oh, right. There was one of those￥too.
Careful you don't catch it.
An annual in the daisy family?
That would be three years.
Look it up in a dictionary.
Gillian, have you forgotten?
The Hundred Days' ＠赤REIGN＠白, remember?
The revolution is ＠赤OVER＠白, remember?

strings.en_src: You pass...￥The videophone's no good.￥Meet at the usual place!!
strings.long_src: All right, you pass. We can't talk￥on the videophone. Meet me at the￥usual place!
strings.long: Ладно, сойдёт. По видеофону говорить￥нельзя. Встретимся на обычном месте!

strings.en: В этот раз не подведи! Живо сюда!
strings.long_src: Don't stand me up this time! Get￥over here!

strings.en_src: I know. I'll be waiting here.

strings.en: Похоже, ты и правда настоящий. По￥видеофону говорить нельзя. Приходи к￥＠赤"Альтамире"＠白 в районе EXG!
strings.en_src: So you're real...￥The videophone's no good. Come￥to ＠赤Altamira＠白 in EXG area.￥We meet there!!
strings.long_src: All right, you seem to be the real￥thing. We can't talk on the￥videophone. Meet me outside ＠赤Altamira＠白￥in the EXG district!

strings.en_src: Huh? Well, I'm a well-read man.

strings.long_src: (Maybe this isn't his first time.)

strings.en_src: Recall the password answer￥you saw on Gaudi.
strings.long_src: Try to remember the password answers￥you saw on Gaudi.
strings.long: Вспомни ответы на пароль, что ты￥видел в Гауди.

strings.en: Давай ещё раз проверим пароли в￥Гауди.
strings.en_src: Let's check the passwords on Gaudi￥again.

strings.en: Что такое, Гиллиан? Ты же у нас￥начитанный.
strings.en_src: What's wrong, Gillian? I thought you￥were a well-read man.
Why don't we look up Napoleon on￥Gaudi?

strings.en: Что это был за пароль? Может, поищем￥Наполеона в Гауди?
strings.en_src: What was that password about? Why￥don't we look up Napoleon on Gaudi?

strings.en: Тогда пока. Подучись и звони снова!
strings.en_src: ...See you then, so long.￥Go and study up!
strings.long_src: Goodbye, then. Come back when you￥have studied some more!
Your line was busy.

strings.en_src: Yes, I was making a call.

strings.long_src: Does it bother you?

strings.en: Не волнуйся. У меня нет друзей.
strings.en_src: Don't worry. I don't have any￥friends.

strings.long_src: Your line was busy again.

strings.en_src: I'm sorry. Were you trying to call?

strings.long_src: Huh?

strings.en_src: Oh? Looks like it worked a little.
strings.long_src: Oh? It seems to have worked a￥little.
I was testing you, Gillian.

strings.en_src: I'm sorry. I was so lonely I￥couldn't stand it.

strings.en: Хотелось, чтобы кто-то за меня￥волновался. Прости. Больше не буду.
strings.en_src: I wanted someone to worry about me.￥I'm so sorry. I won't do it again.
I'm sorry, Gillian. I have to hang￥up now.

strings.en: Я ухожу, Гиллиан. Мне надо￥отключаться. Прости.
strings.en_src: I'm on my way out, Gillian. I have￥to hang up. Sorry.
I'll hang up now, Jamie. See you.
You're hanging up without a word,￥Gillian?

strings.en: Джейми, честно говоря, я хочу начать￥всё сначала.
strings.en_src: Jamie, the truth is, I want us to￥start over.

strings.en: Не надо об этом, Гиллиан. Уверена,￥пока мы порознь, мы лучше поймём￥друг друга.
strings.en_src: Gillian, don't say that now.￥We understand each other better￥apart, for now. I'm sure...
strings.long_src: Don't bring that up, Gillian. I'm￥sure we'll understand each other￥better if we stay apart for now.

strings.en: Пусть память не вернётся никогда,￥Джейми. Я хочу начать сначала!
strings.en_src: I don't care if my memory never￥comes back, Jamie. I want us to￥start over!
Gillian, I can't bear hurting each￥other! Memory matters to a marriage.￥...I can't live a lie.
strings.long_src: I don't want us to hurt each other￥anymore, Gillian! Our memories￥matter to our marriage. I can't keep￥living a lie.
strings.long: Я не хочу, чтобы мы снова ранили￥друг друга, Гиллиан! Для брака важны￥общие воспоминания. Я не могу жить￥во лжи.

strings.en_src: We can make new memories, Jamie!￥Together.
I can't go on without you.

strings.en: Ты так говоришь, Гиллиан, но честен￥ли ты со мной?
strings.en_src: Gillian, listen to you. ...You're￥not lying to me?
strings.long_src: You say that, Gillian, but are you￥being honest with me?
Honest? What do you mean?

strings.en_src: Chatting up all sorts of￥women, I hear?
strings.long_src: I hear you've been flirting with all￥sorts of women.

strings.en: Не вини его. Он за меня беспокоился.
strings.en_src: Don't blame him. He was worried￥about me.
Doing this job, I've come to feel...
strings.long_src: This job has made me realize￥something.

strings.en_src: Maybe our suspicions are what create￥them.

strings.en: Может быть. Если бы все доверяли друг другу, мы бы их изгнали.
strings.en_src: Maybe so.￥If everyone trusted,￥we could drive them out...
strings.long_src: Maybe. We might be able to drive￥them out if we all trusted each￥other.

strings.en_src: Where there's trust,￥doubt is born too.
strings.long_src: Well, trust and suspicion go hand in￥hand.
strings.long: Что ж, доверие и подозрение всегда￥идут рука об руку.

strings.en_src: Gillian, a JUNKER can't afford￥to get emotional, can he?
strings.long_src: You can't let your emotions get the￥better of you as a JUNKER, can you,￥Gillian?

strings.en: Я не вынесу опознавать твоё тело с￥оторванной головой.
strings.en_src: No... Identifying your body￥with its neck torn off...
strings.long_src: I couldn't bear to identify your￥body with your head twisted off.

strings.en: Быть ДЖАНКЕРом куда опаснее, чем я￥думал.
strings.en_src: JUNKER work is far more dangerous￥than I thought.
strings.long_src: Being a JUNKER is a lot more￥dangerous than I thought.
But compared to military training,
strings.long: Но по сравнению с армейской муштрой

strings.en_src: I feel more at ease working as a￥JUNKER.

strings.long_src: Are you pushing yourself too hard?

strings.en: Страшно, конечно. Но теперь я знаю,￥ради чего живу.
strings.en_src: I'm scared, sure. But now I know￥what I'm living for.

strings.en: Честно, я была в шоке, когда узнала, что ты пошёл в ДЖАНКЕР.
strings.en_src: Honestly, I was shocked to hear￥you'd joined JUNKER.

strings.en: Я не знал, как тебе сказать. Прости.
strings.en_src: I couldn't find a way to tell you.￥I'm sorry.
That's all right. Just be careful.
Call me here if anything happens.

strings.en: Не выходи по ночам, Джейми. Ночью￥вылезают снатчеры. Это опасно.
strings.en_src: Jamie, better not go out at night.￥Snatchers are about... it's risky.
strings.long_src: Stay in at night, Jamie. That's when￥the Snatchers come out. It's￥dangerous.

strings.en: Со мной всё будет хорошо. Кому я￥нужна? Они ведь охотятся только на￥важных персон?
strings.en_src: I'll be fine. They wouldn't snatch￥someone like me. They only target￥VIPs, don't they?
They say distrust spreads.￥Surveys call it worse than￥when STBO was rampant...
strings.long_src: More and more people are losing￥trust in others. Surveys say it's￥worse than during the STBO outbreak.
strings.long: Люди всё меньше доверяют друг другу.￥Опросы говорят, что хуже, чем во￥время эпидемии STBO.

strings.en: Может, они хотят разрушить доверие,￥на котором держится общество.
strings.en_src: Maybe they're trying to destroy the￥trust that holds society together.
I hear no such rumours here.￥I've never seen one...
strings.long_src: I haven't heard any rumors among the￥people I know. I've never seen one￥either.
strings.long: Среди моих знакомых никаких слухов￥нет. И я ни одного не видела.

strings.en: Они реальны. Они убили моего коллегу￥- оторвали ему голову.
strings.en_src: They're real... a colleague￥was killed, his neck torn off.
strings.long_src: They're real. They killed a￥colleague of mine by twisting his￥head off.

strings.en: Мне страшно, Гиллиан. Пожалуйста, не рискуй зря.
strings.long_src: I'm scared, Gillian. Please don't do￥anything reckless.

strings.en_src: What is it? Just tell me.
Have you ever been to Altamira,￥Jamie?

strings.long_src: You must have mistaken someone else￥for her, Gillian.
strings.long: Ты, наверное, её с кем-то спутал,￥Гиллиан.

strings.long_src: What? What do you mean?

strings.en_src: Gillian! Let's drop this, shall we?

strings.long_src: Catching up

strings.en_src: Not bad. How about you, Gillian? Are￥you eating properly?
Getting by. I miss your special￥spaghetti, though.

strings.en: А втайне ты не рад, что избавился от￥моей стряпни?
strings.en_src: Aren't you secretly glad to￥be rid of my cooking?
strings.long_src: Aren't you secretly relieved to be￥free of my cooking?

strings.en_src: Same as ever.￥Just work... it keeps￥loneliness away.
strings.long_src: Same as always. I spend all my time￥working. It takes my mind off the￥loneliness.
strings.long: Всё как всегда. Всё время работаю.￥Так меньше чувствуешь одиночество.

strings.en: С работой легче. Когда занят, день￥проходит быстрее.
strings.en_src: Working is easier...￥The day passes in the rush.
strings.long_src: Work makes it easier. Staying busy￥gets me through the day.

strings.en: Как работа, Джейми? Ты всё ещё в￥фармлаборатории?
strings.en_src: How's work, Jamie? Are you still at￥Kobe Pharmaceuticals?
Yes. Maybe this job suits me.

strings.en: Почему-то кажется, что я уже￥занималась чем-то подобным.
strings.en_src: Somehow I feel like I've done this￥kind of work before.
Special work, yet you￥do it well?
strings.long_src: How do you manage such specialized￥work?
strings.long: Как ты справляешься с такой узкой￥специальностью?

strings.en_src: Yes... it puzzles me too.￥The knowledge is there.
strings.long_src: It surprises me too. I seem to￥remember the technical knowledge.
strings.long: Сама удивляюсь. Технические знания￥будто всплывают в памяти.

strings.en_src: I'm hoping this work might help￥bring my memory back.

strings.long_src: Memory
Any sign of your memory coming back?

strings.en: Совсем нет. Счастливые дни с тобой,￥наша совместная жизнь - ничего не￥помню. А ты, Гиллиан?
strings.en_src: None at all...￥Our happy memories, the days we￥lived together, not one of them￥comes back... And you, Gillian?
strings.long_src: Nothing at all. The happy times with￥you, the days we lived together. I￥can't remember any of it. What about￥you, Gillian?

strings.en_src: Same here.￥Nothing before I woke in an army￥hospital bed three years ago...
strings.long_src: Nothing for me either. I can't￥remember anything before waking up￥in that military hospital three￥years ago.
strings.long: И я ничего. Не помню ничего до того,￥как очнулся в военном госпитале три￥года назад.

strings.en_src: It'll take a long while yet...
strings.long_src: It looks like it'll take a lot￥longer.

strings.en: Эта работа - моя единственная надежда вернуть память.
strings.en_src: The only key to my memory is￥to keep at this work.
strings.long_src: Keeping at this job is my only hope￥of getting my memory back.
Has anything happened around you?

strings.en: Гиллиан, если бы я была снатчером,￥ты смог бы меня убить?
strings.en_src: Gillian, if I were a Snatcher, could￥you kill me?

strings.long_src: What brought that on?

strings.en: Вот за это я тебя и люблю, Гиллиан.
strings.en_src: That's what I love about you,￥Gillian.

strings.en: Но из-за этого тебя могут убить.
strings.en_src: But it could get you killed.

strings.en: Странно, но мои знакомые не￥чувствуют особой угрозы.
strings.en_src: It's shocking, but the people I know￥don't feel particularly threatened.
Overreaction scares me more.￥The witch hunts and all that...
strings.long_src: I'm more afraid of people￥overreacting. Those witch hunts, for￥instance.
strings.long: Меня больше пугает, когда люди￥перегибают. Вся эта охота на ведьм,￥например.

strings.en: Говорят, некоторые страны на саммите￥предлагают уничтожить весь город.
strings.en_src: They say some summit nations propose￥wiping out the whole city.
strings.long_src: I've heard some countries at the￥summit are proposing to destroy the￥entire city.

strings.en: Все считают, что они спятили. Кто￥такое допустит?
strings.en_src: Everyone's appalled. As if that￥could be allowed. They're mad.
strings.long_src: Everyone thinks they're out of their￥minds. How could anyone allow that?
Where you went
Are you going somewhere, Jamie?

strings.en: Совру, если скажу, что мне всё￥равно.
strings.en_src: I'd be lying if I said it didn't￥bother me.

strings.long_src: It's my regular checkup.
For your memory treatment?
Yes, with that doctor.

strings.en_src: Oh, I see...￥With that old man, I needn't worry.
strings.long_src: Oh, I see. I don't need to worry￥about that old man.
strings.long: А, понятно. Насчёт того старика￥можно не волноваться.

strings.en_src: You never know.￥I like older men lately.
strings.long_src: You never know. Older men appeal to￥me these days.
strings.long: Как знать. Мне теперь нравятся￥мужчины постарше.

strings.en: Правда? Тогда попробую ещё раз,￥когда немного постарею.
strings.en_src: Really? Maybe I'll try again when￥I'm a little older.

strings.long_src: Dream

strings.en: Что тебе снится, Джейми? Всё тот же￥сон?
strings.en_src: Jamie, what do you dream lately?￥Still that dream?
strings.long_src: What have you been dreaming about,￥Jamie? Still having that dream?
Yes, the same dream over and over.
strings.long: Да, один и тот же сон снова и снова.

strings.en: Я несу ребёнка и бегу от огня.
strings.en_src: I'm holding a child,￥running from a fire.
strings.long_src: I'm carrying a child, running from a￥fire.

strings.en_src: I keep running,￥the fire keeps up.
strings.long_src: No matter how far I run, I can't get￥away from the flames.
strings.long: Как бы далеко я ни бежала, от￥пламени не уйти.

strings.long_src: Then what?

strings.en: Становится так жарко, что я не￥выдерживаю. Я бросаю ребёнка.
strings.en_src: It gets so hot I can't stand it￥anymore. I leave the child behind.
The fire keeps growing, blazing￥bright red.

strings.long_src: What about the child?

strings.en_src: But the child is as cold as ice.

strings.en: Может, запишешь сон на дрим-кодер в￥следующий раз?
strings.en_src: Would you record the dream￥on a dream coder?
strings.long_src: Could you record the dream on your￥dream coder next time?

strings.en_src: I want to dream it too.
strings.long_src: I want to have the same dream as￥you.
strings.long: Хочу увидеть тот же сон, что и ты.

strings.long_src: No. It's such an awful dream.

strings.en_src: It may have to do with our past.
strings.long_src: It might have something to do with￥our past.
strings.long: Он может быть связан с нашим￥прошлым.

strings.long_src: Under the sheets
What is it, Gillian?

strings.en: Конечно. Я никогда не сплю в белье.
strings.en_src: Of course. I never wear underwear to￥bed.

strings.long_src: It just went under your sheet!

strings.en_src: Quick, Jamie! Take off the sheet!

strings.long_src: So that's what you were up to?
You're as dirty-minded as ever.

strings.en_src: Who was that on the phone?
strings.long_src: Who were you on the phone with?
strings.long: С кем ты говорила по видеофону?

strings.en_src: Why?￥Someone you can't tell me about?
strings.long_src: Why? Is it someone you can't tell me￥about?
strings.long: А что? Это кто-то, о ком нельзя мне￥рассказать?

strings.long_src: What does it matter who it was?
Was it a man?

strings.en_src: I'm not obliged to tell you.
strings.long_src: I don't owe you an explanation.
It was a man?

strings.en: Ты всегда так. Всё сводишь к этому.
strings.en_src: You always do this. You twist￥everything into that.

strings.en: Это тот доктор? Который лечит твою￥память?
strings.en_src: That doctor, was it?￥The memory cure...?
strings.long_src: Was it that doctor? The one treating￥your memory?
Someone who has nothing to do with￥you.
strings.long: Человек, который не имеет к тебе￥отношения.

strings.en_src: Jamie, who kept you on￥the phone so long?
strings.long_src: Tell me who you were talking to for￥so long, Jamie.
strings.long: Скажи, с кем ты так долго говорила,￥Джейми.

strings.long_src: Was it the doctor treating your￥memory?
You're being ridiculous!
We're free to do what we want!

strings.en: Оба. Никто из нас не вправе￥вмешиваться. Разве нет?
strings.en_src: Neither of us has any right￥to interfere.￥Isn't that so?
strings.long_src: Both of us. Neither of us has the￥right to interfere. Don't you agree?

strings.en: Кому я звоню и с кем сплю - не твоё￥дело!
strings.en_src: Who I call or sleep with is none of￥your business!

strings.long_src: Are you sleeping with someone,￥Jamie?!
I'm hanging up, Gillian!

strings.en: Может, поговорим, Джейми? Например,￥за ужином. Давно не виделись.
strings.en_src: Could we talk, Jamie? Maybe over￥dinner. It's been a while.
I found a nice place called Outer￥Heaven.

strings.long_src: It's a costume pub. What do you￥think?

strings.en_src: Want to see a musical, Jamie?

strings.en: Сходим в биозоопарк, Джейми?￥Говорят, там родился детёныш￥единорога.
strings.en_src: Want to go to the Bio Zoo, Jamie? I￥hear a baby unicorn was born.

strings.long_src: Sea

strings.en: Поехали на пляж, Джейми! Куда￥хочешь? Пляж Асия, Старая Сума, парк￥Майко?
strings.en_src: Jamie, let's go and see the sea!￥Where to? ...Ashiya beach, Old￥Suma... Maiko Park?
strings.long_src: Let's go to the beach, Jamie! Where￥would you like? Ashiya Beach, Old￥Suma, Maiko Park?

strings.en: Он закрыт, но я знаю, как пройти.
strings.en_src: It's closed off, but I know a way￥in.
My JUNKER ID will get us through.

strings.long_src: It's an all-weather beach, so we￥won't be cold.

strings.en_src: No. You know I hate wearing a￥swimsuit.
strings.long: Нет. Ты же знаешь, я терпеть не могу￥купальники.

strings.long_src: Because of your appendix scar? You￥worry too much.
strings.long: Из-за шрама от аппендицита? Зря ты￥переживаешь.

strings.long_src: Amusement park

strings.en_src: Shall we ride the zero-gravity￥ferris wheel at Neo Portopia?￥You can forget work entirely.
strings.long_src: Let's ride the zero-gravity Ferris￥wheel at Neo Portopia Land. We can￥forget about work and everything￥else.
strings.long: Давай прокатимся на￥антигравитационном колесе обозрения￥в "Нео-Портопия Ленд". Забудем о￥работе и обо всём.

strings.en_src: I'd like you to wear a skirt, if you￥can.

strings.en: Пойдём посмотрим на Драгон Форса. Ты￥ведь любишь лошадей?
strings.en_src: Let's go see Dragon Force. You like￥horses, don't you?

strings.long_src: The Arima Memorial race is coming￥up, isn't it?

strings.en: Может, выпьем в лаунже отеля￥"Нео-Портопия"? Полюбуемся ночным￥видом.
strings.en_src: Shall we drink in the Neo Portopia￥Hotel lounge, watching the night￥view?
strings.long_src: How about a drink in the Neo￥Portopia Hotel lounge? We can enjoy￥the night view.

strings.en_src: You like Moonsalt, don't you, Jamie?

strings.en: Сходим в игровой зал в Харборленде?
strings.en_src: Want to go to the arcade at Harbor￥Land?

strings.en: Он куда больше "Майнд Вейва". Сейчас￥туда ходит куча парочек.
strings.en_src: It's much bigger than Mind Wave.￥Lots of couples go there these days.
I'll win you a toy with the￥superconducting crane.
strings.long_src: I'll win you a stuffed toy you like￥on the superconducting claw machine.
strings.long: Выиграю тебе плюшевую игрушку в￥сверхпроводниковом автомате с￥клешнёй.

strings.en: Я знаю парня, который там работает.￥Нисси.
strings.en_src: I know a guy who works there called￥Nisshy.

strings.long_src: VR Aquarium

strings.en: Как насчёт VR-аквариума? Говорят,￥там будто гуляешь под водой.
strings.en_src: How about the VR Aquarium? They say￥it feels like you're walking￥underwater.

strings.en: На "Охоте на Челюсти" в это время￥года народу немного.
strings.en_src: The Jaws Hunt event shouldn't be too￥crowded this time of year.

strings.long_src: And you wouldn't need a swimsuit.

strings.en_src: Is that your JUNKER ID? It's￥surprisingly stylish.
Gillian, I'm glad.￥Now you have proof of who you are...
strings.long_src: I'm glad you have something to prove￥who you are now, Gillian.
strings.long: Я рада, что теперь тебе есть чем￥подтвердить, кто ты, Гиллиан.

strings.en: О деньгах не волнуйся. У меня есть￥работа.
strings.en_src: Don't worry about money. I have my￥job.
So you're paid properly...￥That's a relief.
strings.long_src: I'm relieved to hear you're getting￥paid properly.
Candy
What's that candy?

strings.en_src: Gibson's. He was to￥be my partner.
strings.long_src: It belonged to Gibson. He was￥supposed to be my colleague.
strings.long: Она принадлежала Гибсону. Он должен￥был стать моим напарником.

strings.long_src: That candy?

strings.en_src: He gave it to orphans, I hear.
strings.long_src: They say he handed it out to￥children at an orphanage.
strings.long: Говорят, он раздавал их детям в￥приюте.

strings.long_src: He must have been a kind man.
Evidence
Scrap of paper

strings.en_src: This was a message from Gibson.

strings.long_src: "Search the house!" What could that￥mean?

strings.en: Ключ от стола Гибсона. Жаль, не от￥твоего сердца.
strings.en_src: It's the key to Gibson's desk.￥Wish it opened your heart.
strings.long_src: It's the key to Gibson's desk. I￥wish it were the key to your heart.

strings.en: Моё сердце не заперто, Гиллиан. Оно￥всегда открыто.
strings.en_src: My heart isn't locked, Gillian. It's￥always open.

strings.long_src: Chess piece
Did you find a machine that could￥read that disk?
strings.long: Ты нашёл машину, которая читает этот￥диск?

strings.en: Да. На нём была зацепка насчёт￥снатчеров.
strings.en_src: Yes. A lead on the Snatchers￥was inside.
strings.long_src: Yes. It had a clue about the￥Snatchers on it.
I'm surprised a machine that old￥still exists.
strings.long: Удивительно, что такая старая машина￥ещё существует.

strings.long_src: A floppy disk? You don't see those￥often.
What's that sunscreen?

strings.en: Похоже, снатчеры мажутся им от рака￥кожи.
strings.en_src: Apparently Snatchers use it to￥prevent skin cancer.
Snatchers use that sunscreen? That's￥news to me.

strings.en: Боюсь, наш институт не занимается￥кремами от солнца.
strings.en_src: I'm afraid our institute doesn't￥work with sunscreen.
Sunblock?￥No need for it this season.
strings.long_src: Sunscreen? You don't need that this￥time of year.
strings.long: Крем от солнца? В это время года он￥не нужен.

strings.long_src: Take a look at this, Jamie.
That's a Koitsu mask, isn't it?

strings.en: Ты всё ещё играешь в такие игрушки,￥Гиллиан?
strings.en_src: Gillian, still playing￥with things like that?
strings.long_src: You're still playing with things￥like that, Gillian?
Photo

strings.en: Это Гибсон? У него ведь была дочь?
strings.en_src: Is that Gibson? He had a daughter,￥didn't he?

strings.en: Будь он жив, он бы тебя понял.
strings.en_src: If he'd lived, he would have￥understood you.

strings.long_src: He looks scary. Is he a suspect?

strings.en: Прости, Гиллиан. Я ещё не готова.
strings.en_src: I'm sorry, Gillian. I'm still not￥ready.

strings.long_src: Don't let it get you down, all￥right?
Probably because it's a black￥market.
About the store

strings.en: В "Джой Дивижн" есть всё, что нужно,￥без всяких ID и по самым низким￥ценам в мире.
strings.en_src: Our Joy Division is the cheapest￥shop in the world, stocking all,￥no ID required...
strings.long_src: Joy Division has everything you￥need, no ID required, at the lowest￥prices in the world.

strings.en: Наши постоянные клиенты знают:￥никакой мутной атмосферы обычного￥чёрного рынка.
strings.en_src: We enjoy the custom of a great many￥shoppers, and none of the gloom of￥the old black markets.
strings.long_src: Our many loyal customers know we￥have none of the shady atmosphere of￥a traditional black market.

strings.en: Мы открыты круглосуточно, без￥выходных. Заходите. Визит скажет￥больше, чем я.
strings.en_src: We're open 24 hours a day, every￥day. Come see us. A visit will tell￥you more than I could.

strings.long_src: Store location

strings.en: Пятая улица, район K Санномии.￥Работаем по всему району.
strings.en_src: Sannomiya K district, 5th street.￥That whole area.
strings.long_src: Fifth Street, Sannomiya K District.￥We cover the whole area.

strings.en: Мы ведь сейчас на Пятой улице?
strings.en_src: Aren't we on 5th street right now?
strings.long_src: We're on Fifth Street right now,￥aren't we?
We look forward to your visit.

strings.en: Отключился, не сказав ни слова.￥Прямо телефонный хулиган.
strings.en_src: Hung up without a word...￥Just like a prank call.
strings.long_src: You hung up without saying anything.￥That was practically a prank call.

strings.en_src: The line seems to be busy.
